root_cause: server/daemon_client.py route_rpc (shared CLI/MCP entry) unconditionally injected workspace_instance_id (via _ensure_remote_snapshot) and workspace_root (params.setdefault) for every RPC not in _NO_WORKSPACE_METHODS, including task-scoped authority requests. The daemon task.prompt.compile parse_request (frozen spec 4.1-3) accepts only task_id + optional expected_workspace_instance_id and fails closed on any unknown field -> CLI/MCP surfaces returned E_TASK_PROMPT_TASK_ID_REQUIRED instead of the compiled bundle.
fix: route_rpc now computes is_task_scoped = _is_task_scoped_authority_request(params) (non-blank task_id or superseded_id) BEFORE the workspace injection block and skips the entire workspace_instance_id / workspace_root injection for task-scoped requests. The Rust handler resolves the numeric workspace from the immutable task_workspace_bindings; the client-side workspace fields are neither needed nor accepted. Workspace-scoped methods (task.create without task_id, lease event listing without task_id, workspace.status/list, etc.) keep the existing injection path unchanged.
